top_signals.title: Gold Slips Below $4,000 on Hot Inflation, Tech-Stock Rout
top_signals.summary: Gold fell below $4,000 an ounce — on track for a second monthly loss — as rising oil prices added to inflationary pressures and a tech-stock rout raised the risk of investors selling the metal to cover losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Weil Gotshal Private Equity Partner Blakey to Jump to Simpson
top_signals.summary: A Weil Gotshal & Manges private equity partner, Lewis Blakey, in London is set to move to Simpson Thacher & Bartlett, marking the latest exit from the stricken Wall Street law firm, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
